---
title: "Send your first simulated voice note"
---

In this tutorial, you’ll send a two-second sample from a simulated Venu 4 to the Android inbox. The sample plays automatically when it arrives.

## Before you start

Install Connect IQ SDK 9.3.0 or newer and set up the Venu 4 45 mm profile and the Android virtual phone. See the [simulator test reference](simulator-test-reference.qmd) for the Android build requirements. Leave the Voicenotes receiver stopped.

## Send the sample

1. Run `just android-emulator` in its own terminal and wait for the phone to boot.
2. Build and start the inbox from the repository root.

   ```sh
   just android-build
   just android-preview demo
   ```

3. Run `just garmin-simulator` and then `just garmin-run-fixture` (it builds with `--companion`). In the Garmin simulator, choose **adb Connection → Start**. Wait for **Connected · inbox up to date** in Android.
4. Press START on the simulated watch. The watch generates a WAV and adds it to **Saved notes**. The Android inbox receives and plays it.
5. Check that the watch shows **On phone**. Tap **Play note** on Android to hear the sample again.

Use the [simulator test guide](run-simulator-tests.qmd) to repeat delivery, reconnect, and app-exit checks and collect the results.
